## Documentation review

- [ ] Accuracy: identifiers, signatures, commands, paths, versions, measurements, schemas, errors, and behavioral guarantees match their authoritative sources.
- [ ] Warrant: every claim is supported by repository evidence or clearly labeled uncertainty; unsupported claims and internal process context are absent.
- [ ] Reader utility: the intended reader can use, change, operate, or reason about the documented system without missing prerequisites, boundaries, risks, or consequences.
